'''Serak''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], worked at [[The Pit (arena)|the Pit]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He provided [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] players with [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] and other items.
